title: Organisational design
learning_outcomes: Explain organisation structures in the context of organisational design.
Compare and distinguish decision rights in the context of organisational design.
Apply coordination in the context of organisational design.
Evaluate and justify decisions about accountability in the context of organisational design.

lessons.title: Organisation structures
lessons.outcome: Explain organisation structures in the context of organisational design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving organisation structures; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to organisation design proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain organisation structures from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of organisation structures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Decision rights
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish decision rights in the context of organisational design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving decision rights; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to organisation design proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain decision rights from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of decision rights; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Coordination
lessons.outcome: Apply coordination in the context of organisational design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving coordination; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to organisation design proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain coordination from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of coordination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accountability
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about accountability in the context of organisational design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accountability; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to organisation design proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accountability from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accountability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of organisation structures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of decision rights; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of coordination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accountability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
